name: Inheritance
source:
When your father's shot at a conference, you go to war against your half-siblings to prove you're the best candidate to be his successor.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Inheritance]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当你的父亲在一次会议上被枪杀时，你与同父异母的兄弟姐妹展开了战争，以证明你是他的继任者的最佳人选。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Inheritance]Choices Wikia[/url]]
